_doc: Hard allow-list for tools/astra_agent.py. DENY RULES OVERRIDE EVERYTHING: a command is refused if any deny
token / phrase / regex matches, if it carries an internal identifier (hostname, IP, URL, e-mail, home path,
a value of gpu/hosts.env), or if any path escapes the repo. Only then is the allow-list consulted.
The deny scan runs on the raw text AND on the shell-tokenized form, so quotes or repeated whitespace cannot
split a denied token or phrase ('r''m' is rm, 'git  commit' is git commit, "import sub""process" is
Local commands run WITHOUT a shell (argv from shlex): ; | && || $( ) ` are refused; > and >> only into the
write sandbox or /dev/null. local_option_deny refuses per-program options after the prefix matched: git is
inspection-only (--output[=]<file> and any abbreviation of it would write ANY file; -O<orderfile> reads one;
--ext-diff runs a helper). Node commands go ONLY through the ssh wrappers, which resolve the host themselves:
bash gpu/a40_ssh.sh '<remote>' (node 1) and bash gpu/ovx_ssh.sh '<remote>' (node 2); the remote string is
checked token by token (prefix, pipe segments, redirections, nohup, the GPU argument).
<venv312> is a placeholder for the Python 3.12 venv (this file's venv312, or $ASTRA_VENV312).
_local_option_deny_doc: per-program (argv[0] basename) regexes matched against every option token of a LOCAL command once its allow-list prefix matched; a hit refuses the command. git: --output[=]<file> makes git diff / git log write their output to ANY file (it bypasses the redirect guard and the python guard, and truncates the target), so it and every git abbreviation of it (--o, --ou, --out, --outp, --outpu) are refused; -O<orderfile> reads an arbitrary file; --ext-diff runs an external helper. --output is also a global deny token below.
_python_guard_doc: every local python run gets a sitecustomize guard (PYTHONPATH) that refuses file writes / deletes / renames outside the write sandbox and temp dirs, refuses os.system/os.popen, scans subprocess argv against the deny list and refuses os.kill of non-child pids. An accident guard, not an OS sandbox.

node_names.ovx: node 2 (8xA40 #2, lease to ~2026-09-21; every GPU occupied by legacy lives)

_node_smoke_gpus_doc: THE GPU ARGUMENT OF ANY SMOKE SCRIPT MUST BE 6 ON NODE 1 (the free GPU). Node 2 has no free GPU: smoke scripts are disabled there (empty list) until a human edits this file. CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES may not be set by the remote string at all.
_runs_dir_doc: transcripts of OTHER runs are unreadable and unwritable; the current run's directory is readable
